picks.editorial_note: A White House-backed consortium uniting 15 universities across 10 states to pool supercomputing resources marks a major federal push to build regional AI research infrastructure at scale.
picks.title: UK partners with regional universities in super intelligence computing consortium

picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission, spotlighted at the National Academy of Engineering, connects national supercomputers, datasets, and experimental facilities into a unified AI-for-discovery infrastructure — a signal of how federal science policy is reorganizing around AI.
picks.title: NAE Annual Meeting Spotlights DOE’s New Genesis Project and Other AI Initiatives Aimed at Advancing Discovery

picks.editorial_note: A $20M NSF-funded supercomputer opened to researchers nationwide significantly expands shared AI compute capacity beyond a single institution, lowering barriers for the broader research community.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Opens Supercomputer to Researchers Nationwide

picks.editorial_note: A $19.2 million, five-year Army Research Office award for AI-enhanced optical sensing and imaging represents a substantial infusion of defense research funding into university-led AI science.
picks.title: UCF-Led Team Receives $19.2 Million Army Research Office Award to Advance the Science of Light

picks.editorial_note: ESMDynamic dramatically accelerates simulation of protein motion, a genuine scientific advance with direct implications for drug discovery and structural biology research.
picks.title: AI model offers a faster way to explore how proteins move, study finds

picks.editorial_note: AURORA's robot-controlled, AI-enhanced cloud laboratory for quantum materials discovery exemplifies how automation and AI are beginning to directly accelerate experimental science.
picks.title: Robots and AI Could Speed Search for Quantum Materials

picks.editorial_note: An Intel-backed platform giving all ASU students and researchers access to advanced AI supercomputing is a notable industry-academia partnership democratizing access to high-end compute.
picks.title: ASU provides access to AI-supercomputing for all

picks.editorial_note: Google.org's $5 million commitment to Georgia Tech broadens researcher access to AI tools and computing for scientific discovery, reflecting continued big-tech investment in academic AI infrastructure.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Receives $5 Million From Google.org to Expand Access to AI for Scientific Discovery

picks.editorial_note: A $1.6 million Google.org grant is funding an AI platform at UCT mapping genetic variants affecting drug metabolism in African patients — a concrete real-world application with public-health impact.

picks.editorial_note: NJIT spinout OppyAI's commercialization of private hybrid AI technology shows university research translating into a scalable, privacy-preserving commercial product.
